      <title>Vonage: ServiceNow Alliance Executive</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>All Other Remote</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> UK - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!</strong></h2></div><h2><strong>Vonage Sales Mission</strong></h2>
<p>At <strong>Vonage</strong>, we’re redefining how businesses communicate in today’s fast-moving digital, cloud, and real-time world. Our Sales team is high-energy, customer-focused, and relentlessly innovative - committed to delivering cutting-edge UCaaS, CCaaS, and AI-powered solutions.</p>
<p>As a <strong>ServiceNow</strong> <strong>Alliance Executive</strong>, you’ll be at the forefront of our ServiceNow ecosystem strategy—expanding our footprint and influence by building and managing powerful relationships.</p>
<h2><strong>Why this role matters:</strong></h2>
<p>The <strong>ServiceNow Alliances team</strong> is a key growth engine for Vonage—driving pipeline and revenue by aligning our business with ServiceNow and its extended ecosystem. This role is perfect for someone who thrives on relationship-building, strategic partnerships, and go-to-market execution.</p>
<p>We’re looking for someone experienced in the <strong>ServiceNow ecosystem</strong> or with a strong background in <strong>partner management or alliances</strong>. If this sounds like you—keep reading!</p>
<h2><strong>Your key responsibilities:</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Drive Servicenow <strong>referral business</strong></li>
<li>Build, nurture, and manage relationships with <strong>Servicenow teams and ecosystem partners</strong></li>
<li>Align Vonage’s sales reps with their Servicenow counterparts to generate <strong>pipeline and close opportunities</strong></li>
<li>Own <strong>executive alignment and sales engagement</strong>—position Vonage asServicenow’s top communication partner</li>
<li>Plan and lead <strong>joint field events</strong> with Servicenow (both partner-facing and customer-facing)</li>
<li>Collaborate cross-functionally within Vonage to maintain <strong>momentum on partner strategy and joint outcomes</strong></li>
<li>Coordinate and run <strong>interlocks, milestone tracking, and strategy sessions</strong> with partners and internal stakeholders</li>
<li>Drive execution of regional <strong>go-to-market strategies</strong> with Servicenow and other alliance partners</li>
<li>Deliver internal training sessions to equip Sales, Product, Services, and Support teams on partner ecosystem updates</li>
<li>Represent Vonage at <strong>industry events</strong>, promoting our brand and ecosystem value</li>
<li>Manage <strong>technical and business escalations</strong> to maintain partner success and deal velocity</li>
<li>Execute against established <strong>revenue, activity, and relationship goals</strong></li>
<li>Support ongoing optimization of alliance processes to enhance partner program impact</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Who you are:</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>A relationship-driven professional who thrives in a partner-centric ecosystem</li>
<li>Experienced in working with alliances, channel sales, or ecosystem partnerships</li>
<li>Strategic and detail-oriented with a passion for joint value creation and partner enablement</li>
<li>Capable of influencing cross-functional teams and engaging with executive-level stakeholders</li>
<li>An excellent communicator—able to tailor messages to various audiences and formats</li>
<li>Comfortable analyzing complex data and solving problems with a collaborative mindset</li>
<li>Experience within the Servicenow ecosystem is a plus</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>What you'll bring:</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Bachelor’s degree in Sales, Marketing, Business, or a related field</li>
<li>Proven experience in Alliance Partner Management, Partner Sales, or Channel Development</li>
<li>Strong track record of recruiting, onboarding, and enabling partners</li>
<li>Prior experience or familiarity with the Salesforce ecosystem is a must</li>
<li>Prior direct sales experience is a huge plus&nbsp;</li>
<li>A desire to succeed and a “get-it-done” attitude</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>How you’ll benefit:</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Competitive base salary + performance-based incentives</li>
<li>Fully remote flexibility&nbsp;</li>
<li>Dynamic, inclusive, and supportive team culture</li>
<li>Career advancement opportunities with a clear growth path</li>
<li>Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits</li>
<li>Unlimited discretionary PTO and tuition reimbursement</li>
<li>Opportunities to work on industry-defining technologies and partnerships</li>
</ul>
<p><span>#LI-MB2</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>There’s no perfect candidate.</strong> You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.</p>
<p>To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our <a href="https://www.vonage.com/legal/careers-privacy-notice/"><span class="s1"><strong>Privacy Notice</strong></span></a>.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Who we are:</strong></p>
<p>Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.</p>
<p><span>Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. Assignments may differ for individuals within the same role based on business conditions, departmental need or geographic location.&nbsp;</span></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/vonage-servicenow-alliance-executive">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/vonage-servicenow-alliance-executive</a></p>
</description>

    <item>
      <title>Mixpanel: Procurement Counsel</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>All Other Remote</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Mexico City, Mexico (Remote)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Mixpanel</strong></p>
<p>Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at <a href="mixpanel.com">mixpanel.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>About Mixpanel</strong></p>
<p>Mixpanel is an event analytics platform for builders who need answers from their data at their fingertips—no SQL required. When everyone in the organization can see and learn from the impact of their work on product, marketing, and company revenue metrics, they are poised to make better decisions. Over 9,000 paid customers, including companies like Netflix, Pinterest, Sweetgreen, and Samsara, use Mixpanel to understand their customers and measure progress. Our commitment is to provide the most comprehensive and reliable analytics platform accessible and trusted by all.</p>
<p><strong>About the Role</strong></p>
<p>We are looking for a motivated, collaborative, and business-minded Procurement Counsel to join our Legal Team. The Procurement Counsel will report to Sr. Corporate Counsel, and will&nbsp; have the strategic ability to oversee and negotiate key deals and relationships and act as a trusted business partner for the organization. The ideal candidate will have experience working in-house for global businesses, executing and negotiating commercial transactions and contracts, building processes, and executing efficiently on a day-to-day basis. You will primarily focus on supporting procurement and vendor negotiation and onboarding, partnering closely with internal teams such as marketing, engineering, and finance to align contracts with business needs. You will frequently interact with internal stakeholders and external parties, creating relationships based on trust while helping Mixpanel navigate the business environment, challenges, and objectives.</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Strategically partner with internal business stakeholders to draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements including vendor agreements for software, professional services, corporate services, equipment, data licenses, NDAs, independent contractor engagements, and event sponsorships to ensure that Mixpanel, its customers, personnel, and partners are protected.</li>
<li>Evaluate risk factors impacting business decisions and anticipate unique legal issues that could affect the company, providing timely and practical legal advice on agreement structure, approval processes, and company policies.</li>
<li>Assess and advise on risks associated with vendors' use of artificial intelligence (AI), including evaluating AI-related contractual provisions, model training, and data usage rights, output ownership, indemnification implications, accuracy and liability disclaimers, and compliance with applicable AI regulations.</li>
<li>Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, including Marketing, Finance, Engineering, Procurement and People Operations, Privacy, and Security, to develop processes and enforce applicable policies as they relate to global commercial contracting.</li>
<li>Supplement and create processes, templates, and playbooks and support the deployment of software and systems for efficient and scalable contracting to better serve business needs.</li>
<li>Enable and train internal stakeholders by providing direct guidance on processes, structure, and commonly requested revisions, non-standard terms, and respond to general process questions timely and accurately.</li>
<li>Stay informed of emerging laws, regulations, and judicial decisions relevant to our business; conduct thorough research to understand the implications of these developments, and communicate or make necessary changes to controls, policies, and procedures to appropriate parties.</li>
<li>Ability to prioritize and triage high volume of requests balancing risk, criticality, and resource constraints.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Manage escalations and collaborate across other teams to provide counsel regarding the business environment and objectives.</li>
<li>Support and manage a variety of ad hoc projects with the Legal team as they arise; be extremely versatile, highly responsive, and pitch in for anything needed in the Legal department, even if it’s unfamiliar or not in your lane.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>We’re Looking For Someone Who:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>JD degree or equivalent degree from an accredited school, along with the necessary professional licensing to practice law</li>
<li>1-3 years of relevant experience, with specific experience negotiating SaaS agreements.</li>
<li>Direct experience with a variety of legal matters, including strategic business agreements, information security and compliance, intellectual property rights, and privacy related matters including negotiating data protection agreements and advising on data privacy questions and concerns.</li>
<li>Familiarity with legal and commercial issues arising from AI and machine learning technologies, including experience reviewing and negotiating AI-related contract terms such as data usage rights, model training limitations, and liability allocation for AI outputs.</li>
<li>Strong negotiating skills with both legal and commercial issues, and a demonstrated ability to create legal, defensive, or proactive strategies.</li>
<li>Excellent knowledge and understanding of contract law and basic corporate law.</li>
<li>A champion of change with a proven ability to build operationally excellent processes and practices.</li>
<li>Strong interpersonal and presentation skills, with the ability to develop a strong rapport and working relationship with business counterparts across the enterprise to help drive the delivery of effective legal services.</li>
<li>​​Outstanding communication skills, both verbal and written, and a demonstrated ability to establish and maintain collaborative working relationships.</li>
<li>Strategic thinker with a focus on practical solutions that are geared towards reducing company risk while being fair and balanced.</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to work flexibly and efficiently, prioritize work and meet demanding deadlines in a fast-paced environment, especially during quarter-end.</li>
<li>Willingness to roll up sleeves and take on tasks both big and small with an eagerness to learn; a collaborative approach with a low ego in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment across a range of time zones.</li>
<li>Strong sense of ownership and responsiveness with the ability to juggle multiple assignments and prioritize appropriately to support cross-functional projects.</li>
</ul>
<p>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Benefits and Perks</strong><strong><br></strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care</li>
<li>Mental Wellness Benefit</li>
<li>Generous Vacation Policy &amp; Additional Company Holidays</li>
<li>Enhanced Parental Leave</li>
<li>Volunteer Time Off</li>
<li>Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break</li>
</ul>
<p><em>*please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary*</em></p>
<p><strong>Culture Values</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Make Bold Bets:</strong> We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.</li>
<li><strong>Innovate with Insight:</strong> We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive&nbsp;powerful outcomes.</li>
<li><strong>One Team:</strong> We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.</li>
<li><strong>Candor with Connection:</strong> We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.</li>
<li><strong>Champion the Customer:</strong> We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.</li>
<li><strong>Powerful Simplicity:</strong> We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Why choose Mixpanel?</strong></p>
<p>We’re a leader in analytics with over 9,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.</p>
<p><span>Mixpanel is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. At Mixpanel, we are focused on things that really matter—our people, our customers, our partners—out of a recognition that those relationships are the most valuable assets we have. We actively encourage women, people with disabilities, veterans, underrepresented minorities, and LGBTQ+ people to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance or other similar laws that may be applicable, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We’ve immersed ourselves in our Culture and Values as our guiding principles for the impact we want to have and the future we are building.</span></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/mixpanel-procurement-counsel">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/mixpanel-procurement-counsel</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Talkspace: Account Coordinator</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>All Other Remote</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New York, NY (Remote)
</p>

<p><span>At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!<br></span></p>
<p><span>We are looking for an experienced Account Coordinator to join our team. The Account Coordinator is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders with clients, ensuring they have a smooth and positive experience with Talkspace services. They act as a point of contact for existing accounts: providing exceptional service, addressing client needs, and resolving issues. In addition to supporting accounts, this is a heavily cross functional role: this person will be the main liaison between the Account Management team and internal matrix partners collaborating extensively with the Implementation, Sales, Marketing, Revenue Cycle Management and Product teams to ensure alignment. The role requires maintaining detailed records and reporting on account performance, providing actionable insights to senior leadership to drive client success. To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.</span></p>
<p><span><em><span>This is a remote position based on Eastern Time. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC.</span></em></span></p>
<p><span><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li>Client&nbsp;Relationship Management<br>○ Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders&nbsp;at clients, ensuring high customer satisfaction and retention. &nbsp;<br>○ Serve as a point of contact for existing accounts, providing exceptional service and support to meet their needs. &nbsp;<br>○ Regularly engage with clients to understand their evolving&nbsp;business needs and mental health goals. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Internal&nbsp;Collaboration<br>○ Serve as the main liaison between the Account Management&nbsp;team and the Payor Success team: coordinating cross-team&nbsp;efforts, sharing insights, and driving consistent partner&nbsp; engagement and resolution. &nbsp;<br>○ Work closely with the Sales, Marketing, and Product teams to&nbsp;ensure alignment on client needs, feedback, and product&nbsp;offerings. &nbsp;<br>○ Provide valuable feedback to the product and engineering teams&nbsp;on customer preferences, challenges, and opportunities for new&nbsp;features. &nbsp;<br>○ Collaborate with the Revenue Cycle Management and Finance&nbsp;teams on claims resolution and collection opportunities. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Client&nbsp;Onboarding &amp;&nbsp;Implementation<br>○ Collaborate with the Implementation and Customer Success&nbsp;teams to ensure seamless onboarding for new clients, helping&nbsp;them launch Talkspace’s services successfully. &nbsp;<br>○ Monitor client engagement and utilization, providing&nbsp;recommendations for increasing adoption and ensuring a smooth&nbsp;experience. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Reporting &amp;&nbsp;Analytics<br>○ Maintain detailed records of client interactions, engagement&nbsp;metrics, and progress using CRM software. &nbsp;<br>○ Monitor account health metrics and proactively address any&nbsp;issues to ensure client satisfaction and continued success. &nbsp;<br>○ Report on account performance and provide actionable insights&nbsp;to senior leadership. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Performs&nbsp;other&nbsp;related&nbsp;duties&nbsp;as&nbsp;assigned.</li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>About You</strong><span>&nbsp;</span></span></p>
<ul>
<li>1+ years of experience in account management, client success, or sales,&nbsp;with a focus on Payor accounts. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Experience in B2B2C mental health-related industries is highly&nbsp;preferred. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build&nbsp;trust and rapport with senior-level executives. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to &nbsp;<br>manage multiple accounts and projects simultaneously. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Experience with CRM software (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.) and &nbsp;<br>data-driven decision-making. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Results-oriented with a passion for delivering value to clients and &nbsp;<br>driving business growth. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Proactive, self-motivated, and able to work independently in a &nbsp;<br>fast-paced environment. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Empathetic and customer-focused, with a genuine interest in improving &nbsp;<br>mental health outcomes for those we serve. &nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>Benefits&nbsp;</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans coverage</span></li>
<li><span>Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA</span></li>
<li><span>401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 4%</span></li>
<li><span>Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.</span></li>
<li><span>Monthly Wellness Stipend to promote mental and physical self-care</span></li>
<li><span>Flexible PTO and Remote First Environment</span></li>
<li><span>Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events</span></li>
<li><span>Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount!&nbsp;</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>Compensation</strong></span></p>
<p><span>At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.</span></p>
<p><span>The base salary range for this role is between $60,000 - $70,000. Within the salary bands, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications.&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span><strong>Why Talkspace?&nbsp;</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.</span></p>
<p><span>Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse&nbsp; “for purpose” space. If you’re equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!</span></p>
<h3><span>EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER</span></h3>
<p><span>Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional — such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record — if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.</span></p>
<p><span>Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.</span></p>
<p><span><strong>How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?&nbsp;</strong></span></p>
<p><span><strong>Diversity</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.</span></p>
<p><span><strong>Equity</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.</span></p>
<p><span><strong>Inclusion</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.</span></p>
<p><span><strong>Belonging</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.</span></p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/talkspace-account-coordinator">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/talkspace-account-coordinator</a></p>
